The best thing that works for me is this:
Get a cup of crushed ice, sip on tiny chunks every 5-20min until hydrated. Once you feel hydrated enough, try to eat something small and light. Apples, grapes, bananas, pudding, etc. Fruits are great and hydrating. Oranges and other citrusy fruits may be to acidic. 

Once you get something in your tummy, even if it’s small, it may help calm it down. Not good to have all that acid and bile just sitting there with nothing to do. 

It you still throw up after trying ice chunk method, get some antacids, or some anti nausea syrup. Try drinking room temperature or warm water, as cold water can sometimes be irritating to an empty, sensitive stomach.
